sTrack 3.4 User Manual

Offline Gantt, board, sprints and timesheet · Click any picture to enlarge

1. Getting started

Use this the first time: install, create a project and set its working calendar.

  1. Run sTrack.exe (Windows 10/11) or open sTrack-web.html in a browser. Fully offline.
  2. Pick the look of アシス・トラ (the guide) → Let's start.
  3. Alt+N → guided (9 steps: basics, calendar, roles, team, …), empty, easy sample or full sample.
  4. Alt+S → working days, MH/day, holidays.
  5. Plan on the Gantt, track on Board / Sprints / Timesheet, save with Ctrl+S.

Data lives in %LOCALAPPDATA%\sTrack (exe) or a shared team file. Saved plans use .strack.json.

4. Gantt

For the PM: break work into tasks, set dates, link them, then compare plan with actual.

  • Insert add · Shift+Enter save + next task (plain Enter just saves) · Alt+→ indent (8 levels) · right-click for more.
  • F2 details: names, status, PIC, start, days, MH, Done %, actual, After rows (= arrows).
  • Empty start = after its predecessors. Weekends/holidays skipped.
  • A row with sub-tasks has no PIC of its own ("↳ sub-tasks"). If a PIC can't be assigned, click the cell and アシス・トラ tells you why.
  • Milestones and events: ▲ ▼ in Days move the date by one working day; in MH they add / take 1 MH.
  • Drag bars on the chart to move dates; drag a bar's right end to change its days (snaps to working days, Ctrl+Z undoes). In Plan vs Actual: upper bar = plan, lower = actual.
  • Sprint rows: Sprint ▾ (Ctrl+6) → pick a sprint. Tasks under it belong to that sprint; select it + Insert to add inside. Assigning a sprint elsewhere moves the task under its row. The row's Start (type, or ▲ ▼) moves the whole sprint.
  • Fold by level: the toolbar box (Alt+L) shows Level 1 only, Levels 1–2, … or Unfold all. The arrow beside a name still folds one group.
  • Alt+V Plan vs Actual · Alt+B baseline · Alt+F needs attention.

5. Board · Sprints · Timesheet · Reports

Day-to-day tracking: move work forward, run sprints, log hours, and report status to the customer or your manager.

  • Board Alt+2: drag cards or Ctrl+1…6; drag the bar for Done %.
  • Sprints Alt+3: goal, burndown, tasks.
  • Timesheet Alt+4: hours per day; Actual and/or Burndown MH; Ctrl+6 Excel (MH and Note side by side). Right-click a day to write a note; Show notes lists them under the hours; F2 shows all notes of a task.
  • Reports Alt+6: Ctrl+1 copy, Ctrl+2 PNG.

6. Team

Who works on the project and when they are available, so the plan matches real capacity.

  • Members: photo, two names, nickname, Role (drop-down), MH/day. The list also offers common team roles to add.
  • Roles tab: Add role ▾ picks from common team roles or a custom one; rights per role (no passwords).
  • Schedule: weekly routine and leave · Outlook (classic) or .ics import.
  • Alt+W shared team database file. Opening a plan file or New project disconnects you from it (pending changes are saved first); the team plan is not touched.
  • Alt+K Back up now: a full copy of the plan, stored in the team database when connected. Open ▸ Backups… to restore (the current plan is backed up first). Connecting keeps your previous local plan as a backup.
  • Merge: on reconnecting, or Open ▸ Merge from a plan file…, or Backups ▸ Merge…, sTrack lists every difference (Changed / Added / Deleted, field by field) and you tick what to bring in. Your newer changes are ticked for you.
  • Same version for everyone: if the team database was saved by a newer sTrack, yours opens it read-only (🔒) until you update. If it was saved by an older one, アシス・トラ warns you.

7. Settings & export

Set the calendar and look once, then share the plan as Excel, CSV, image or file.

  • Alt+S: Sat/Sun, MH/day, built-in Thai/Japanese holidays.
  • Alt+T: Basic, Dark, Starry Night, Forest, Burning.
  • Ctrl+O: open, import Excel/CSV, export Excel/CSV, save .strack.json.
  • Alt+X lock · Alt+D customer view (read-only).
